annotation.title_clean: 高齢者、障害者等の移動等の円滑化の促進に係る信号機等に関する基準を定める規則
annotation.title_en: Rule Establishing Standards for Traffic Signals etc. for Promoting Smooth Mobility of the Elderly, Persons with Disabilities, etc.
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家公安委員会 (National Public Safety Commission, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese National Public Safety Commission rule setting accessibility standards for traffic signals, road signs and markings under the Barrier-Free Act. The 2023 amendment extends pedestrian-signal crossing provisions to remotely operated small vehicles (delivery robots), specified small motorized bicycles and bicycles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Signals must give audible cues, sufficient crossing time and remaining-time displays for the visually impaired and elderly.
Pedestrian green signals cover pedestrians, remotely operated small vehicles, specified small motorized bicycles and bicycles.
Road signs must use reflective material or night lighting.
Road markings must be reflective or have tactile guidance projections at crosswalks.
Amended effective 1 July 2023 to align with Road Traffic Act revisions.
